title: CapabilityTask
description: A capability task in the DB-backed ledger (source of truth). A worker owns it only after an atomic claim.

eval_suite.description: THE BENCHMARK AS THE SPEC (optional; when present, fully constrained). The evaluation system that DEFINES done — what the runtime gate scores a candidate against and the compiler refuses to bypass. EITHER an inline `examples` suite ({input, expected, weight?} rows, judged + split train/holdout) OR a `benchmark_ref` to a named registry suite; exactly one (XOR enforced in _repos/teleon/backend/src/teleon/purpose_tasks/eval_suite.py). `gate_threshold`/`holdout_policy` default from the single canonical source (scripts.teleon_local_runtime PROMOTE_AT / TRAIN_PARITY), never re-typed. Same shape + helper as PurposeTaskSpec.eval_suite; consumed via src.teleon.purpose_tasks.eval_suite_for(spec).

examples.description: INLINE suite (XOR benchmark_ref): labeled rows the deterministic judge scores; even index = TRAIN, odd = HOLDOUT. A model-built capability MUST have >=1 (enforced in eval_suite.py).

input.description: the example input fed to the capability

expected.description: the answer key the judge scores against (STAFF-ONLY in projections)

benchmark_ref.description: NAMED registry suite (XOR examples); resolved by eval_suite.resolve_benchmark_ref — unregistered ref raises honestly, never a fabricated suite.

holdout_policy.description: train/holdout split policy; DEFAULT derived from scripts.teleon_local_runtime.TRAIN_PARITY.

gate_basis.description: basis the threshold is evaluated over (e.g. 'train+holdout'); stamped from GATE_BASIS.

judge.description: scoring judge; same vocabulary as schemas/benchmark.schema.json. Default deterministic.
